restart_checks.json_state_sha256_basis: exact JSON roundtrip; source and output receipts sealed separately

model_comparison.note: Different probability or target signals do not imply executed advantage; halted accounts cannot trade later differences.

execution: At daily strategy decisions or hourly change in covered FOMC risk flag, request delta to fixed unit-gross target*0.8*risk_scale. Request sizes use preceding close and trailing completed-hour volume. Exits persist at1percent actual5mvolume; entryTTLoneinterval. Confirmed exits settle before entry fills. Entry fills additionally bounded by actual gross/equity after all costs and pending exit inventory. Targets can resize existing same-side campaigns; maintain weighted cost basis, cumulative lifecyclePnL and never loosen stops. No free fills or instant flips: same-symbol reversal closes first and waits until next declared rebalance to reopen.
changes_vs_previous: Earlier frozen engine could only shrink and closed positions before later allocating replacement risk; this version can add size within existing campaigns and condition new-symbol fills on confirmed exit risk release. All candidates/controls use the same version. It is still a5mvolume proxy, not native Freqtrade/real-exchange fills; actual order book/min-notional/queue depth not verified.
